text:
For the iPhone 17, I’d prioritize a slim magnetic power bank with Qi2.2, 25W wireless charging, and at least 5,000mAh. If thinness matters most, a 5,000mAh bank is easier to carry; if you want enough capacity for longer days, a 10,000mAh model is the better compromise.

Based only on the search results you pasted, these are my top picks.

Best slim Qi2 / MagSafe power banks
Best for slimness

1. Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim)

$54.99

5,000mAh · 15W Qi2 · 4.3 oz · 0.34 in thick

At just 8.6 mm thick and 122 g, this is my pick if you want a compact battery that feels closer to a slim MagSafe accessory than a bulky power bank. The 9to5Mac review also praises its premium feel and cooler operation.

Buy from Anker — $54.99

Sources: Anker specifications and price · 9to5Mac review

Best overall value

2. Baseus PicoGo AM52 Qi2.2 10,000mAh

$53.99 with code AM52

10,000mAh · 25W wireless · 45W USB-C

This is my overall pick if you want more capacity without sacrificing fast wireless charging. The supplied results say the coupon was tested on October 24, 2026, at Baseus's US store. It supports 25W Qi2.2 wireless charging on iPhone 17.

Buy the Baseus PicoGo AM52

Enter code AM52 at checkout for the reported $6 discount, bringing the listed $59.99 price to $53.99.

Source: Dealectric deal and specifications

3. INIU SnapGo Air 10K

$54.99

10,000mAh · 25W wireless · 45W wired · 195.4g · 0.5 in thick

A strong alternative if you want 10,000mAh capacity and fast charging in a relatively thin package. Android Central lists it among its slim Qi2 power banks tested in 2026, with a built-in USB-C cable.

Shop or compare at Android Central

Source: Android Central's 2026 slim power bank test

4. LISEN P601 5,000mAh Qi2 Power Bank

Price not provided

5,000mAh · 15W Qi2 · 3.6 oz · 0.30 in thick

An attractive option if you want a particularly thin and lightweight pack. Its listed dimensions are approximately 4.1 × 2.6 × 0.3 inches, and its weight is only 102 g. The trade-off is the smaller capacity and slower wireless charging than Qi2.2 models.

Specifications and prices are taken from the supplied Anker, Baseus, Android Central, and LISEN results.

My recommendation

Choose the Anker Nano if the smallest, slimmest everyday carry is your priority.

Choose the Baseus PicoGo AM52 if you want 10,000mAh capacity and faster 25W wireless charging for roughly the same price.

Choose the LISEN P601 if minimizing thickness and weight matters more than charging speed.

One important distinction: Qi2.2 at 25W is the feature to prioritize for faster wireless charging. The iPhone 17 is covered by the supplied results' compatibility claims for 25W charging. A 15W Qi2 bank is still a good choice, but it won't deliver the same maximum wireless charging speed.
